content: LeetCode official editorials follow a fixed structure per problem: problem restatement, one or more numbered Approaches (Approach 1: Brute Force, Approach 2: Optimized, etc.), each with Intuition, Algorithm/step-by-step walkthrough, Code (often multi-language tabs), and a Complexity Analysis subsection (explicit Time complexity: O(...) and Space complexity: O(...) with justification). This is the de facto template replicated across the ecosystem (GitHub solution repos mirror it).
